title: A moddable item system
description:
Build items so mods can add new ones and change old ones through data and a plugin table.

```
base game: 4 items
mod "fire": adds fire_sword, changes sword.damage
mod "loot": adds a new effect "gold_find" through a plugin function
final: 5 items; fire_sword uses the new effect
```
hints: Load the base game, then each mod's data, then validate once at the end (lesson 13.03).
A plugin (a DLL in the real game) would export a function that receives the effect registry and adds to it.
requirements: Items are data (name, damage, effects); effects are looked up by name in a registry of functions.
Mods add items, change fields, and register new effects.
Validate everything after loading: unknown effects and bad numbers are reported, and those items are left out.
stretch: Make the plugin part real with a DLL and `LoadLibraryW`, following milestone 4.
